create_autoresearch_store: create an _AutoresearchStore instance with a workdir path and state dictionary to manage workflow persistence
load_checkpoint_specs: load queued and running work specs from engine/checkpoint.json to resume an interrupted autoresearch workflow
save_scheduler_state: save the current scheduler state with queued specs, running specs, and status to checkpoint.json and monitoring views
update_workspec_node: update a WorkSpec with new node data and persist the changes to all engine monitoring files
write_text_atomic: write text to a file atomically using a temp file and rename to prevent partial writes
